blocks.text:
The clearest of Folio's four themes: squircle icons, glass without a tint behind it, and a status area stripped back to the time and the battery.

Badges show the number waiting rather than a plain dot, the status glyphs are the minimal set, and the rail behind them is almost invisible. Live icons stay on, so the clock and the calendar keep moving.

A built-in Folio theme. Applying it changes how Folio draws your Home screen and nothing else - it never touches other apps, and every setting it changes can be changed back by hand in Settings.

items: Badges with the count, not a dot

entries.notes: The Clear theme becomes a package in the Folio Market. It has shipped with Folio since 0.4.0.
